title: Fail before semantic spend when required evidence storage is unavailable
description:
The portfolio runner currently begins model-backed diagnosis before proving that required non-model evidence storage is readable. A credential or authorization failure can therefore consume semantic budget and only afterward produce incomplete evidence.

Scenario: required evidence authority is available
  Given a selected semantic diagnosis target
  When the portfolio diagnosis preflight runs
  Then diagnosis may continue under the frozen semantic budget

Scenario: required evidence authority is unavailable
  Given a selected semantic diagnosis target
  When the evidence authority preflight cannot authenticate or read its configured storage
  Then no semantic model call is made
  And the living Report records a sanitized incomplete-evidence blocker and recovery action
  And the run performs no optimizer mutation

Scenario: no semantic target is selected
  Given deterministic assessment selects no semantic diagnosis target
  When the portfolio run continues
  Then the storage preflight is not called.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented the required-evidence preflight and stakeholder-safe incomplete-state projection. When the prerequisite is unavailable, the runner stops before semantic calls or optimizer dispatch, records a high-severity issue and recovery action, and the workbook validator explicitly permits the new prerequisite status fields. Validation: focused prerequisite scenario passed; portfolio 136 passed; runtime contract 280 passed; living Report 88 passed; dispatcher/runner 51 passed. No production mutation or new run was performed.
